question.en: Why can a fast shutter still make a moving subject lean?
question.zh-cn: 为什么快门很快，运动物体仍可能变形？

summary.en: Separate how long each row collects light from when the first and last rows start. A shorter exposure can reduce blur while a timing gap still produces skew.
summary.zh-cn: 分清每行收集光线的时长，以及首末行开始曝光的时差。缩短曝光能减少拖影，行间时差仍可能让主体变形。

boundary.en: Shutter hardware and exposure timing describe different things. A mechanical focal-plane shutter can also expose the frame at staggered times when its curtains form a moving slit. Shutter modes and flash behavior depend on the camera.
boundary.zh-cn: 快门结构和曝光时序描述的是不同的属性。机械焦平面快门的帘幕形成移动狭缝时，画面各处也会错开曝光。实际快门模式与闪光表现要看具体机型。

en: Exposure duration is how long a row collects light. During that interval a moving subject can travel across pixels, leaving a trail. A shorter duration can make that trail smaller.

With a typical rolling shutter, each row gets the same exposure duration but starts and ends at a different time. If a straight object moves sideways, later rows can record it farther across the frame. The image can show a tilted shape even when its edges look sharp.

A global shutter starts and ends exposure at the same time across the frame. Captured data can still be read out afterward. A long exposure can still blur motion even when the rows record the same interval.
zh-cn: 曝光时长是一行像素收集光线的时间。在这段时间里，运动主体可能跨过多个像素，留下拖影。缩短曝光能减少这种拖影。
典型的滚动快门（也叫卷帘快门）让各行曝光同样长，但起止时刻按行错开。直线物体横向移动时，晚曝光的行会记录到它更靠前的位置。即使边缘清晰，整体仍可能倾斜。
全局快门让整帧同时开始和结束曝光，随后仍可读出已记录的数据。即使各行记录的是同一段时间，曝光太长也可能留下运动拖影。
